VBO:0201100.summary: Curious and energetic in her foster account, fourteen-month-old Polly offers an individual glimpse of the Puginese, a Pug–Pekingese cross. She enjoyed fetching small squeaky toys and exploring rooms for things to chew. She was shy with strangers and nervous on unfamiliar walks, becoming affectionate once settled; her foster also described rough, sometimes mouthy play.
VBO:0201100.shortDescription: A Pug–Pekingese cross; Polly’s foster story pairs squeaky-toy fetch and room exploration with shyness and mouthy play.
